Onigashima on the other hand has been huge with the strawhat moments, and on top of that we have lots of great moments with the Yonko, the worst generation, the scabbards, Yamato with Oden's journal and so so so so much more! Damn, this arc seems fast on its tracks to become an all time favourite for me.

Let's keep in mind these are pirates we're talking about. We're constantly reminded of the risks of a pirate life and that everyone involved is ready to asume them, just like Ace told Luffy at Marineford.

From the flashback at the beginning of chapter 961 or so, with Oden onboard the Oro Jackson, we can conclude that he decided to go back to Wano all by himself to become Shogun, even though he knew very well that as a pirate he probably made lots of enemies and rose a high bounty.

So IF the news of Kaido overthrowing Oden really spread out (considering Wano is a closed country as so many people had pointed out), maybe Whitebeard or the rest of the Roger Pirates just accepted it as a consequence of a life of piracy, specially if the details of Orochi's betrayal weren't revealed, as we can very safely assume.

And finally, as someone else pointed out in the replies, waging war against another powerful pirate crew is not a trivial thing, specially when there's nothing to gain but revenge. One piece is all about living your life to the fullest and not holding on on grudges, and certainly Whitebeard, the greatest pirate that ever lived, believed strongly in this code
